title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $299.01 on the Shark AV2511AE AI Ultra robot vacuum
content_html:
SAVE OVER $200: As of Aug. 12, the Shark AV2511AE AI Ultra robot vacuum is on sale for $299.99 at Amazon. That's a $299.01 discount off the list price of $599.

Credit: Shark

$299.99 at Amazon
$599 Save $299.01

The Shark AV2511AE AI Ultra robot vacuum has received a huge 50% discount at Amazon, but it won't be on sale for long. If you've been thinking your home could benefit from the cleaning assistance of a robot vacuum, especially if people are spending more time inside to keep out of the summer heat, you'll want to make a move fast on this limited-time deal.

As of Aug. 12, this robot vacuum has dropped from $599 to $299.99. Don't wait too long to grab it, as it has a "limited-time deal" stacker attached.

Mashable Trend Report

This Shark robot vacuum is a reliable pick for people who just want help with vacuuming around the house. Whether it's carpets, rugs, or hard surfaces, its powerful suction can pick up any dust, crumbs, or pet hair. It even comes with a Matrix Clean feature, which moves in a grid pattern to make multiple passes over areas for a deeper clean.

There's no need to worry about emptying the bagless base frequently, as it can hold up to 60 days' worth of dirt and debris. And on top of that, this robot vacuum can last for up to 90 minutes on a charge. The store page also notes that when it runs out of battery, it returns to the dock for a recharge, then resumes where it left off once it's done, which is very helpful.

Act fast to score 50% off the Shark AV2511AE AI Ultra robot vacuum at Amazon.
